classification: Original captured DM realtime client-state recovery, not a broker/backend or authenticated-session implementation

inputsRequired.userId: resolved auth userId ?? profile fallback userId ?? null
inputsRequired.viewer: separately resolved dm-inbox cache scope; not interchangeable with userId
inputsRequired.connected: CORE connection state; does not itself gate subscription

subscription.subject: dm.user.${userId}
subscription.callback: latest callback ref; callback/viewer change alone does not resubscribe unchanged subject
subscription.cleanup: unsubscribe(type,id) only when both stored type and ID are truthy; reset after successful unsubscribe
subscription.error: log subscribe exception; no fabricated connected state

dedup.scope: one mounted hook lifetime, not reset by viewer/userId changes

peerCallback.when: senderId is defined and differs from resolved userId

refresh.leading: immediate on first unique accepted event
refresh.trailing: one refresh at timer expiry iff pending; no new cooldown from trailing alone
refresh.snapshot: pending timer retains the invalidator/viewer of its first event; later input changes do not cancel/reset it
refresh.errors: query invalidation/peer callback exceptions remain exceptions; no synthetic success

reconnect.sequence: after seeing ready+connected, a ready+disconnected observation sets pending; later ready+connected schedules refresh

visibility.gate: enabled && userId !== null; does not require authReady

dispose: clear outstanding event-window and reconnect timers; remove visibility listener; unsubscribe through source truthy-ID cleanup; instance cannot remount
limits: No NATS transport, token minting, credentials, auth acceptance, broker/server implementation, wire capture, production requests or native compatibility.
No user/profile lookup, React effect scheduling, user-ID/cache-scope inference, browser lifecycle attachment or telemetry service is supplied implicitly.
Injected ports implement local integration. Defaults start disabled; callers must provide current original-derived gate/identity state.
One adapter instance models one hook lifetime, including retained IDs/pending timers across configure calls. Remount creates a new instance.
Captured callbacks/cleanup establish bounded client logic, not upstream delivery, replay, losslessness or exhaustive concurrency semantics.
All available direct import variants are retained. Complete transitive graph and active page provider/build selection remain unknown.
Existing764 foreground message presentation,690 inbox watermark and675 settings UI remain unchanged; no feature ledger credit.
